findings.title: T002 has no durable stop preventing its unconfirmed first-stage candidate from verifying or merging
T007 permits recursive ci-local to test_merge to orchid merge execution without requiring a recursion guard
T010 does not bind operator hand-off edits to a committed candidate_sha or cover merge-created rebases
T010 routes lint findings to implementer guidance while declaring lint fixes operator-only
T001 and T010 may run concurrently despite modifying the same implementing arm and focused test
The bootstrap jobs check, safe checkout refresh, and hand-carried lint procedure has no auditable roadmap checkpoint
Every task falsely requires reporting and performing chmod even when no executable was added
T015 cannot record the required post-merge proof and omits explicit third-party beta and public-release status
